Base SUCS block chart

Every named block of the 31-bit space.

Block Range Space
Unicode Bridge 0000..0010FFFF Unicode Compatibility Space
SuperUnicode Control Plane 00110000..0011FFFF System Control Plane
BANcode 0011A000..0011A7FF System Control Plane
WARNcode 0011A800..0011ABFF System Control Plane
COMcode 0011AC00..0011ADFF System Control Plane
SOFTcode 0011AE00..0011AEFF System Control Plane
Native 00120000..7FFFFFFF Native Space
Traps 7FFFFFF0..7FFFFFFE Native Space (reserved)
Sentinel 7FFFFFFF Native Space (reserved)
